releaseNotes:
Depositly 1.3.1 Build 8

- Moved APK downloads to versioned files on depositly.vercel.app. Settings and the website now read the same deployed update information without requiring GitHub access.
- Successful app release jobs automatically publish the signed APK and metadata into the website repository. Vercel deploys them together; previous versioned downloads remain available.
- Kept SHA-256, package, version and signing certificate checks. The app accepts APK downloads only from the official HTTPS website, including redirects.
- Install this release once from https://depositly.vercel.app/download/ if you use Build 7 or earlier. Future updates can be downloaded from Settings → App updates. Your saved records remain available when installing over the existing app.
